connector.name: ConnectWise Manage
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for ConnectWise Manage PSA - companies, tickets, projects, time entries, and more.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image connectwise-manage-mcp:v1.8.0. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the wyre-technology account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: CW_MANAGE_COMPANY_ID
env.description: ConnectWise company identifier (the short name used to log in)

env.name: CW_MANAGE_PUBLIC_KEY
env.description: ConnectWise API member public key (Members > API Members)

env.name: CW_MANAGE_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Client ID from the ConnectWise Developer Portal (developer.connectwise.com)

env.name: CW_MANAGE_URL
env.description: ConnectWise API base URL — region-specific (api-na/eu/au.myconnectwise.net) or self-hosted

env.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
env.description: Transport mode for the server. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

env.name: AUTH_MODE
env.description: Credential source: 'env' reads vars locally, 'gateway' expects header injection from the WYRE MCP Gateway.

env.name: LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
